filings.summary: Centum Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 24, 2026, titled "Centum Electronics and Pixxel Sign MoU to Advance Indigenous Satellite Payload Technologies".
filings.ns: Centum Electronics Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding with SpacePixxel Technologies Private Limited on 24th November 2026. The agreement was announced at the India International Space Conference 2026 in New Delhi. The parties will explore joint development of advanced satellite payloads. This includes miniaturised Synthetic Aperture Radar electronics and associated subsystems. The collaboration combines Centum's expertise in high-reliability space electronics with Pixxel's capabilities in Earth observation satellites. The companies also intend to explore technical knowledge exchange and new satellite applications. The objective is to develop high-performance satellite platforms and strengthen indigenous space technology capabilities. A copy of the press release is enclosed with the intimation.

filings.name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited
filings.label: USFDA approval / EIR / clean inspection
filings.subject: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited receives USFDA Final Approval for Bosutinib Tablets, 400 mg.
filings.summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 24, 2026, titled "Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited receives USFDA Final Approval for Bosutinib Tablets, 400 mg".
filings.ns: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited received final approval from the USFDA for its supplemental Abbreviated New Drug Application for Bosutinib Tablets, 400 mg. The approved product is therapeutically equivalent to the Reference Listed Drug Bosulif Tablets, 400 mg. Bosutinib is indicated for adult patients with chronic phase Philadelphia chromosome-positive chronic myelogenous leukemia and for those in accelerated or blast phase resistant or intolerant to prior therapy. The company previously received approval for Bosutinib Tablets, 100 mg and 500 mg. The estimated market size for Bosutinib Tablets, 400 mg, is US$ 246 million for the twelve-month period ended September 2026. With this approval, Alembic Pharmaceuticals has received a cumulative total of 248 ANDA approvals from the USFDA, comprising 230 final approvals and 18 tentative approvals.

filings.name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
filings.label: Investor presentation
filings.subject: Investor/Analyst Presentation for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
filings.summary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
filings.ns: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company listed on BSE and NSE on 5th November 2026, raising Rs. 183.05 Crore through its public issue. It acquired 8.48 acres of industrial land at Supa, Maharashtra. Financial highlights for FY26 show revenue from operations at 12,668 Mn, EBITDA at 891 Mn, and PAT at 305 Mn. Revenue CAGR from FY24 to FY26 was 29.51%. EBITDA margin was 7.03% and PAT margin was 2.41%. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was 6,773.19 Mn. Home and commercial appliances accounted for 86.90% of revenue. The company serves 215 customers. It is an authorized service partner for JSW Steel. The earnings conference call is scheduled for Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. IST.

filings.name: Polyplex Corporation Limited
filings.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
filings.subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 (Listing Regulations)
filings.summary: Polyplex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about installing BOPET Film Line project in Thailand
filings.ns: Polyplex Corporation Limited discloses that its material subsidiary, Polyplex Thailand Public Company Limited, has approved a project to add capacity by installing a BOPET Film Line at its Rayong factory in Thailand. The existing capacity is 98,045 MT per year with 80% utilization. The proposed addition includes a BOPET Film Line with an annual installed capacity of 53,000 MT per year and a Metalliser with an annual installed capacity of 11,000 MT per year. The project is expected to be completed within 20 to 24 months from the closure of the main machinery procurement contract. The required investment is THB 2,655 Mn, equivalent to approximately 78.41 Mn USD. Financing will be through a mix of term loans and internal accruals. The rationale is to improve production capacity, efficiency, product quality, operating cost competitiveness, and long-term market positioning.

filings.name: Polyplex Corporation Limited
filings.label: Closure of operations
filings.subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 (Listing Regulations)
filings.summary: Polyplex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about closure of the CPP production line in Thailand
filings.ns: Polyplex Corporation Limited disclosed that its material subsidiary, Polyplex Thailand Public Company Limited, has approved the mothballing or closure of its CPP production line in Thailand. The closure is scheduled for November 2026. This action aims to facilitate the installation of a Specialty BOPP Film Line Project, aligning with the strategy to optimize assets and improve financial performance. The CPP line contributed THB 211.91 Mn, equivalent to INR 610.31 Mn, representing 0.86% of the listed entity's turnover in the last financial year. No binding agreement for the sale of the unit exists. Further updates will be notified in due course.

filings.name: Adani Power Limited
filings.label: Credit rating upgrade
filings.subject: : Disclosure under Regulation 30 (Disclosure of events or information) – Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Affirmation and Assignment of Credit Ratings.
filings.summary: Adani Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
filings.ns: Adani Power Limited disclosed that CRISIL Limited upgraded its credit ratings to CRISIL AA+/Stable from CRISIL AA/Stable for enhanced Bank Loan and Non-Convertible Debenture facilities. The total rated facilities amount to Rs. 90,500 Crore. This includes Rs. 68,000 Crore in Bank Loan Facilities, which were enhanced from Rs. 58,000 Crore, and Rs. 11,000 Crore in Non-Convertible Debentures that were upgraded. Additionally, Rs. 11,500 Crore in Non-Convertible Debentures were assigned the CRISIL AA+/Stable rating. The upgrade reflects the sustained strengthening of the company's business and financial risk profile, supported by a diversified operating portfolio, high proportion of operational capacity tied up under medium- and long-term power purchase agreements, adequate fuel security arrangements, and healthy operating efficiency. The company also noted the multi-factor mitigation of execution risk for its capacity expansion program and its strong market position. This information has been updated on the company website.

filings.summary: EID Parry India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Ravi Karthik as Chief Executive & Business Head - Consumer Products Group of the company w.e.f. November 27, 2026.
filings.ns: E.I.D. - Parry (India) Limited disclosed a change in senior management personnel pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. Mr. Ravi Karthik was appointed as Chief Executive and Business Head - Consumer Products Group, effective November 27, 2026. Mr. Karthik holds over 20 years of experience in FMCG, e-commerce, and telecommunications. He previously served as Chief Growth Officer at ACT Fibernet, where he oversaw sales, marketing, and product functions. Prior to that, he led the small home and personal care appliances business at Flipkart. He also spent eight years at Procter & Gamble in India and international markets. Mr. Karthik is an Electronics and Communication Engineer from SRM Engineering College and holds an MBA in Marketing and Strategy from the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore. He completed Executive Leadership Programs from Harvard Business School and Stanford Graduate School of Business. The company reported no relationships between directors in connection with this appointment.

filings.ns: Nelco Limited disclosed that CRISIL Ratings revised its outlook on November 24, 2026. The long-term rating is Crisil A with a stable outlook, and the short-term rating is Crisil A1. filings.subject: : Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
filings.summary: Rashi Peripherals Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received communication of order on November 24, 2026, from the office of Commissioner of customs (NS-V), Jawaharlal Nehru Custom House, Nhava Sheva, District Raigad, Maharashtra (order passed date: November 12, 2026) as per the details attached herewith.
filings.ns: Rashi Peripherals Limited received an order from the Commissioner of Customs dated 12th November 2026 confirming a demand of Rs. 34,62,17,701. This amount includes differential duty of Rs. 17,31,70,772 and penalty under section 114A of Rs. 17,31,70,772. The demand arises from Show Cause Notice 1834/2025-26 dated 13.01.2026 regarding wrong classification of imported goods. Rs. 1,23,843 was previously paid. The net payable excluding interest is Rs. 34,62,17,701. The company states it has strong grounds to contest the demand. It is consulting tax experts to file an appeal before CESTAT. The demand will be classified as a contingent liability in the financial statements. The order was received on 24th November 2026.

It specifically targets diverse customer segments, including families, millennials, and seniors, with features such as Bengali-speaking tour managers for regional group tours. The location is situated at 01, Dilip Ganguly Sarani, Baranagar, near Dunlop More, Kolkata, with the contact number 9051749730.

filings.name: SRIT India Limited
filings.label: Investor presentation
filings.subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 regarding the Investor Presentation.
filings.summary: SRIT India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
filings.ns: SRIT India Limited filed an investor presentation for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations grew 29.0% year-on-year to Rs. 1047.0 million in Q2 FY27. Profit after tax rose 38.2% to Rs. 137.4 million. Half-year revenue stood at Rs. 1925.1 million with PAT up 17.2% to Rs. 205.5 million. EBITDA margin expanded to 17.2% from 12.8%. Operating cash flow was Rs. 865.34 million. The order book was Rs. 12,047.17 million at June 30, 2026. The company proposed a 50% acquisition in Blossom for Rs. 1400 million. It also proposed a strategic stake in Carnot Research, rising to 20%, for Rs. 50 million. These investments are subject to due diligence and approvals.

filings.name: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited
filings.label: SEBI / tax / ED / raid / penalty
filings.subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Securities Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended (“SEBI Listing Regulations”)
filings.summary: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, please find attached details of order passed by Dy. Commission of State Tax, Udaipur, Rajasthan'.
filings.ns: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited disclosed an order dated 23 November 2026 from the Deputy Commercial Tax Officer, Udaipur, Rajasthan. The order demands tax of Rs. 17,46,092 for ineligible Input Tax Credit claimed under the GST Act. A penalty of Rs. 1,94,610 and interest of Rs. 6,54,425 under Section 50 of the CGST Act, 2017, have also been levied. The company states there is no impact on its financial, operational, or other activities due to this alleged tax demand. The order is appealable, and the company is contesting it at a higher appellate level.

filings.name: Bharti Airtel Limited
filings.label: SEBI / tax / ED / raid / penalty
filings.subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015 (‘SEBI Listing Regulations’)
filings.summary: Bharti Airtel Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
filings.ns: Bharti Airtel Limited received a notice from the Department of Telecommunications, Andhra Pradesh LSA on November 23, 2026. The notice imposes a penalty of Rs. 7,96,000 for alleged violation of subscriber verification norms. The violation stems from a Customer Application Form Audit conducted for June 2026. The company has opted not to contest the penalty and will pay the amount. The maximum financial impact is limited to the penalty levied.

filings.name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited
filings.label: Management / board appointment
filings.summary: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding intimation on demise of Ms. Bhama Krishnamurthy, Independent Director of the company on November 24, 2026.
filings.ns: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited intimates the National Stock Exchange and BSE of the demise of Ms. Bhama Krishnamurthy, Non-Executive Independent Director, on November 24, 2026. Her DIN is 02196839. She had served as an Independent Director since July 31, 2019, and was in her second consecutive term. Consequently, she ceased to be a Director of the Company with effect from November 24, 2026. The Board expresses condolences to her family and appreciates her contributions during her tenure. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

filings.name: Horizon Industrial Parks Limited
filings.label: Investor presentation
filings.subject: Presentation for Investor Conference
filings.summary: Horizon Industrial Parks Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
filings.ns: Horizon Industrial Parks Limited filed a presentation for the 2026 Blackstone Connect investor conference held on November 24, 2026. The company is India's number one industrial and logistics infrastructure platform with a total network of 61 million square feet across 46 assets. The stabilized portfolio occupancy stands at 94 percent. The company targets leasing 6.5 million square feet and developing 6 million square feet in fiscal year 2027. Contracted revenue addition for the first half of fiscal year 2027 reached Rs 125 crore. The in-city portfolio redevelopment commenced in September 2025. The first multi-storey asset launch is planned for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company holds a 45-year partnership with CWC for its in-city sites. Run-rate revenue is projected to grow 2.7 times to Rs 2,700 crore once the 100 million square foot portfolio is fully built.

filings.name: Gland Pharma Limited
filings.label: USFDA approval / EIR / clean inspection
filings.subject: Receipt of EIR from USFDA for Company’s VSEZ Sterile Oncology Formulations Facility
filings.summary: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of EIR from USFDA for Company's VSEZ Sterile Oncology Formulations Facility
filings.ns: Gland Pharma Limited received an Establishment Inspection Report from the USFDA for its VSEZ Sterile Oncology Formulations Facility and API Facility in Visakhapatnam. The inspection occurred between August 24, 2026, and September 01, 2026. The USFDA classified the facility as No Action Indicated. This announcement follows the company's intimation dated September 01, 2026. The company requests that this information be taken on record.

filings.name: HD Fire Protect Limited
filings.label: SEBI / tax / ED / raid / penalty
filings.subject: : Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – Search by DRI
filings.summary: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated
filings.ns: HD Fire Protect Limited disclosed that the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, Mumbai Zonal Unit, conducted a search at the company's Corporate Office in Wagle Estate, Thane, on November 23, 2026. The search commenced at approximately 11:50 hrs and concluded on November 24, 2026, at about 06:30 hrs. The action was taken under the Customs Act, 1962, and relates to the classification and tariff concession claimed on imported finished products. The company stated it extended full cooperation to the authorities. HD Fire Protect Limited reported that there is no material impact on the company's financials, operations, or other activities resulting from this search.

filings.name: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited
filings.label: New product / launch
filings.subject: GSK Launches CDSCO-Approved BLENREP for Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma Please find enclosed the press release issued by the Company regarding the launch of CDSCO-approved BLENREP (belantamab mafodotin) for the treatment o
filings.summary: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 24, 2026, titled "Approved BLENREP for Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma".
filings.ns: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited launched CDSCO-approved BLENREP for the treatment of relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma in India. The announcement was dated 24th November 2026. BLENREP is indicated as combination therapy for adult patients who have received at least one prior therapy. It is approved in combination with bortezomib and dexamethasone, or with pomalidomide and dexamethasone. The therapy targets B-cell maturation antigen. Clinical data from DREAMM-7 and DREAMM-8 trials showed median progression-free survival of 36.6 months and 32.6 months respectively. The drug is administered as a short outpatient infusion.

filings.name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
filings.label: Sale of business / subsidiary / stake
filings.subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
filings.summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Sale or disposal
filings.ns: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited board approved on 23 November 2026 the sale of 2,600 shares, representing 26.00% of Clean Max Gangotri Private Limited, to Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited for INR 26,000. The company will also subscribe to equity shares of Clean Max Gangotri Private Limited up to INR 214.49 crore in tranches. The transaction is a related party matter conducted at arm's length. The target entity was incorporated on 18 September 2026 and has no prior financial history. The sale agreement and shareholders agreement are expected to be executed on or before 31 January 2027. The buyer is not part of the promoter group.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 25: HUL soars 6%, Tata Consumer Products, HDFC Life surge 5%, Tata Steel falls 2%
headlines.summary: On November 25, the SENSEX advanced by 1.82% or 1,502.29 points to close at 83,938.28, while the NIFTY50 ended higher by 469.60 points or 1.85% at 25,819.25.

headlines.headline: SENSEX rallies over 1,300 pts, NIFTY50 above 25,650: Jupiter Wagons, L&T, Brigade Enterprises among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: Brigade Enterprises stock jumped as much as 6.8% to hit an intraday high of ₹621 per equity share on the NSE on Wednesday, as it acquired a 2.25-acre land parcel in Secunderabad, Hyderabad, through an outright purchase at ₹180 crore, with the sale deed registration now completed.

headlines.headline: Mid-market update: Indian equities defend opening gains; NIFTY50 trades above 25,700, SENSEX jumps 1700 pts
headlines.summary: The rally was largely confined to benchmark indices only, as midcap and smallcap indices traded in the red. NIFTY Midcap 100 traded in a flat-to-negative range, and the NIFTY Smallcap 100 index fell 0.62% on Wednesday afternoon.

headlines.headline: Infosys, Mphasis, TCS: IT stocks rally over 4% intraday, NIFTY IT gains 2.6%; what’s powering today’s momentum?
headlines.summary: Indian IT stocks rallied more than 4% during the trading session on Wednesday, November 25, with the NIFTY IT gaining 2.6% intraday as investors focused on the buying sentiment and the anti-AI trade amid a global market selloff.

headlines.headline: L&T shares jump over 2% on securing BESS order worth ₹1,000-2,500 crore in Gujarat; key details
headlines.summary: The project will feature a three-hour BESS, with a power capacity of 300 MW and an energy storage capacity of 900 MWh, L&T said.

headlines.headline: NIFTY Bank soars over 2% as ICICI Bank shares hit 52-week high; HDFC Bank, Axis Bank lead gains
headlines.summary: The NIFTY Bank index was supported by buying in the shares of ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, Axis Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank, which were among the top winners.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50 tops 25,700 in early trade, SENSEX up 1,400 pts; financials, Infosys among top gainers
headlines.summary: Global cues remain mixed, with investors rotating away from some US technology stocks towards other sectors. This could favour Indian domestic cyclicals and financials if buying broadens beyond a handful of index heavyweights.

headlines.headline: Profit booking: NIFTY50 drops 450 points, SENSEX falls 1.77%; Metals, and Banks among top laggards
headlines.summary: Weakness in global equities and the dollar index resulted in sharp selling pressure in metal stocks, which were the key laggards in today’s trading session. Tata Steel (-8.5%), Axis Bank (-3.9%), HDFC Bank (-3.3%), ICICI Bank (-3.3%), and Hindalco (-3.1%) were the top losers in Monday’s trading session.

headlines.headline: No 9:15 AM opening bell today: What's keeping Dalal Street shut on Tuesday, November 24?
headlines.summary: Trading across the equity and equity derivatives segments will remain suspended for the entire day. This means benchmark indices Sensex and NIFTY50 will not see any trading activity.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 23: Tata Steel tumbles over 8%, Axis Bank falls 4%, TCS jumps 3%; check list
headlines.summary: On November 23, the SENSEX declined by 1,483.72 points or 1.77% to close at 82,435.99, while the NIFTY50 fell by 450.95 points or 1.75% to end at 25,349.65.

headlines.headline: Axis Bank to Apollo Hospitals: 6 NIFTY100 stocks hit 52-week high despite stock market fall
headlines.summary: The real estate major DLF jumped 1.3% to hit 52-week high on Monday. It had reported a 10% jump in consolidated net profit of ₹1,301 crore for Q2 FY27.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX erase early gains to trade lower after strong opening; TCS, Shriram Finance, among top gainers
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices erased their early market gains on Monday, November 23, as investors booking profits while focusing on FII investment sustainability and global market selloff amid steady oil prices and US Treasury yields.

The spotlight now shifts to other big companies that have high valuation in the unlisted space. From Reliance Retail to Parle Products, here are the 13 companies whose IPOs investors are looking forward to.

headlines.headline: ICICI Bank to Meesho: Top 5 stocks hit record highs on November 20; how much have they gained?
headlines.summary: Several stocks, including big names like ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, among others have rallied to hit a fresh record high on Friday, November 20, with investors focusing on the sustained FII buying support and the trend reversal powering the intraday gains.
